changelog: 🚀 JIN v2.2.4 Dual-Edition Release: Full Multi-Agent & Mobile-Harness Suite APK + Pure Antigravity 2.0 PC-Grade Edition APK.

⚡ Edition #1 (jin-termux-v2.2.4-release.apk): Complete 6-Agent CLI Suite (Antigravity, Claude Code, OpenCode, DeepSeek, Codex, OpenRouter), Zero-Key Free AI Gateway, Harness Studio, Jin Fusion, and 100 PC Power Tools.

💎 Edition #2 (jin-antigravity-only-v2.2.4-release.apk): 100% Pure Google Antigravity 2.0 PC-Grade Edition — zero third-party agents or bloat, ultra-fast 60fps token streaming, Subagents Manager (self, research, image-generator + custom subagents), GEMINI.md / AGENTS.md Rules & SKILL.md Skills Studio, /schedule Cron Manager, and PC Security Sandbox.

🎙️ Fixed Live Voice Assistant: Hybrid Android SpeechRecognizer + 16kHz PCM AudioRecord VAD + Cloud Whisper Fallback, async TTS queue pre-warming, Bangla/English auto-detection, and 2.2s Direct Voice AI Fallback.

🔓 Fixed Chat UI & Auth Loop: Eliminated infinite 'Checking account status...' loop, removed blocking API key walls with automatic Zero-Key Cloud Gateway fallback, and fixed single-line Project Picker buttons.
